name: Rallar Server RTC connect and send
description: Uses the current logged-in browser-rallar session to connect to bb-group over RTC and send a JSON payload.

requires: Run rallar-server-group-ws-setup first, or otherwise ensure bb-group exists and the logged-in user has joined it.
Open the SPA with provider=browser-rallar and log in before loading this recipe.
For visible delivery in another browser, run the same setup/connect flow for a second logged-in user in bb-group.
notes: This recipe uses the current runtime config for apiBaseUrl and restored auth session.
The send command omits peerIds so the active Rallar realtime implementation can route according to the joined group.
